answer: The thread register is checked at draw time, wharf lists the eligible set, and canyon seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 70 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 70 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A farm of 100 pays that 132 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
